messages.content: In 12 years, Charmaine will turn 16. What will be her age after 4 years?

content.text:
Charmaine will turn 16 in 12 years, so she is currently **4 years old** (16 − 12 = 4).

After 4 years, she will be **8 years old** (4 + 4 = 8).
